snippet.title: BunnyOps Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Bunnies are the apex herbivore. Carrots are scarce. Play tactically to secure your carrot supply. Break stuff. 

Bunny Ops is a team-based tactical PVP shooter with a fully destructible environment. It follows the military operations of two opposing tactical units in key hot zones shortly after the Cold Carrot War broke out into armed conflict. 

Add BunnyOps to your wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4037840/BunnyOps/
